english.title: Act as flight crew of UK aircraft when aggregate of previous flight times exceeded limit
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) acted as a member of the flight crew of an aircraft registered in the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), when, at the beginning of the flight, the aggregate of all your previous flight times during the period of

(A)_[28 consecutive days expiring at the end of the day on which the flight begun exceeded 100 hours]_
(B)_[twelve months expiring at the end of the previous month exceeded 900 hours]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 177 and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
